reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a branded trading-pool offer requiring at least $100 in Bitcoin while associating the contribution with a potential 10% to 13% monthly balance increase. It also offers referral commissions and binary bonuses tied to maintaining a financial position and obtaining two direct referrals, while directing viewers to account registration and funding information. The monthly figure is qualified as historical and not guaranteed, and no outcomes or payments are established.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
Your bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.
Once you start building a team, to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals.
If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission

opening.argument: The presentation describes a conditional trading opportunity rather than promising a fixed outcome. Its return language is expressly framed as anticipated and historical, with the visual qualification “not guaranteed.” The contribution is also presented as optional: viewers may add to the account “when and if you want,” and the speaker says that someone who only wants to invest needs no further information. Those qualifications are material risk and uncertainty signals, so the content can reasonably be understood as cautious financial information rather than deceptive certainty.

citations.quote: Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.
If you just want to invest, that is all you need to know.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The contribution requirement and projected increase do not by themselves establish deception. The return is expressly qualified as historical and not guaranteed, while the account language says additions are discretionary. Referral and bonus terms describe optional participation, not proof that every viewer is promised income. The presentation therefore contains the uncertainty and choice that the opposing account overlooks.

citations.quote: If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not change the central message: viewers are asked to join a branded trading pool with Bitcoin and are shown an anticipated 10% to 13% monthly increase. Calling the figure historical or not guaranteed still presents it as the expected growth of a deposited balance. The optional language concerns adding more funds, not whether the initial Bitcoin contribution is required.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.

opening.argument: The format is an introductory explainer for people deciding whether they need more information. It is explicitly titled “The Basics,” says that no trading knowledge is necessary, and directs interested viewers to more detailed material about the business, registration, funding, and the binary system. That structure is consistent with an educational overview or operational demonstration: it explains how the service is described and where to learn more, without showing a completed transaction, a withdrawal, or a guaranteed personal result.

citations.quote: The Basics - Mirror Trading International
No trading knowledge is necessary.
There are more detailed videos available describing the business, how to register and fund your account, understanding the binary etc. should you wish to learn more.
Withdrawals take up to 48 hours to process.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling an explainer educational does not erase what it explains. The lesson is specifically about joining a trading pool, anticipated monthly growth, referral commissions, and qualification for binary bonuses. The registration and funding follow-up is especially consistent with directing viewers toward participation, even though the video does not show a completed transaction.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission
to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The title and introductory tone do not make this neutral instruction. The explanation tells viewers the minimum Bitcoin contribution, describes trading on their behalf, presents anticipated monthly growth, and supplies a route to registration and funding. No completed withdrawal is needed to identify the promoted offer; the absence of demonstrated results does not convert a solicitation into ordinary education.

citations.quote: Your bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.
how to register and fund your account

opening.argument: At most, this is a description of a service with a stated entry price, account operation, processing period, and optional referral incentive. The material does not show a demand for credentials, a completed payment, a specific guaranteed payout, or an actual recruitment outcome. The referral language is conditional—“If you want”—and the bonus has stated eligibility requirements rather than an unconditional promise. Without evidence of deception, loss, or an unavoidable downline mechanism, the content can be treated as ordinary service and referral promotion.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
Withdrawals take up to 48 hours to process.
If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission
to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The missing items are not necessary when the mechanism is stated directly. The service requires Bitcoin for a trading pool, associates that balance with anticipated monthly growth, and links bonuses to a financial position and two direct referrals. A claim need not show a victim, credentials, or completed payout before it can be a deceptive investment promotion.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.
to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The omitted evidence is not the relevant test. The video itself presents a branded pool that accepts Bitcoin, says the Bitcoin is traded for the viewer, and advertises an anticipated 10% to 13% monthly increase. It also offers direct referral commission and binary bonuses conditioned on maintaining a position and recruiting two people. Those are the operative features, regardless of whether a completed payment or credential request is shown.
